question: Which of the following types of additives is mixed with lubricants to reduce the surface tension of the oil?
solution:
The correct answer is __Emulsifier**.**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Emulsifiers__ are additives used in lubricants to reduce the surface tension of the oil.
 
• They help maintain a stable mixture between oil and water by preventing them from separating.
 
• Emulsifiers are essential in applications where water-based lubricants are required for cooling and lubrication simultaneously.
 
• They improve the lubrication properties of oils by ensuring consistent distribution.
 
• These additives are commonly used in metalworking fluids and other industrial applications.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mist Suppressors:**

 
 
• These are additives that minimize the formation of oil mist during high-speed operations.
 
• They help reduce environmental hazards caused by oil mist dispersion.
 
 
 
• **Tackiness Agents:**
 
 
• These additives are used to enhance the adhesion of the lubricant to the surface.
 
• They prevent the lubricant from dripping or being flung off during operation.
 
 
 
• **Demulsifiers:**
 
 
• Demulsifiers separate water from oil in lubricants.
 
• They are commonly used in applications where water contamination needs to be removed.
